title: Observation recorder update delivery repair
details: Fixes the update loop that could reload the old Milos shell and offer the same update again
The updater now waits for the new service worker to take control before reopening Milos
The updated shell is refreshed from the network before Milos reopens so the 2.58 recorder finalisation repair actually loads
No review, calendar, mileage, QR, course, evidence or document behaviour is changed in this release
